name: prism-toolshop-playwright
description: Playwright UI + API automation for Toolshop (practicesoftwaretesting.com) - QA GenAI assessment

scripts.test: playwright test; e=$?; node scripts/collectEvidence.js; exit $e
scripts.test:smoke: playwright test --grep @smoke; e=$?; node scripts/collectEvidence.js; exit $e
scripts.test:regression: playwright test --grep @regression; e=$?; node scripts/collectEvidence.js; exit $e
scripts.test:ui: playwright test "tests/UI Test"; e=$?; node scripts/collectEvidence.js; exit $e
scripts.test:headed: playwright test --headed; e=$?; node scripts/collectEvidence.js; exit $e
